style: Dark, cinematic, brand-led. Top-down camera: an orange ball falls from the centre towards the floor, hits it and releases a shockwave of hexagons (large enough to read as geometry) with acid orange glowing between the cells; the wave leaves the frame, everything is black, and the ball becomes the framing-L logo.

asset_needs.source: brand manual geometry (viewBox -60 -60 320 320, two L polygons) — inlined

content.logo: inline SVG: orange badge #FF5B14 + L1/L2 in #1D1D1D

phases.motion: top-down fall: size = 1/(1-0.55h), h = 1-u² (gravity); the floor under it lights up as it nears
squash 1.16, small bounce, floor flash + 2px shake
canvas hexagon floor (R = min(W,H)/38) lit by an expanding ring; orange between cells; two rings; leaves pure black
ball rotates -90→0 and squares off into the badge; L pieces slide in from opposite corners
LUCAS DOMINGUEZ / STUDIO tracks in, hold

notes: Registry search (hexagon shockwave ripple / honeycomb grid reveal / logo reveal ball impact) returned no items, so the hex shockwave is hand-authored on a seek-safe canvas driven by the paused timeline.
